description: Purpose of this region: standing instructions and conventions that everyone working here is expected to follow.
content:
This region holds normative material: how work is to be done here, not what happened.

Belongs here: rules, conventions, house style, things that must always or never be done, and the reason behind each.

Does not belong here: one-off requests (scope.org_tasks) or observations about how the system behaves (the scope.pwnc_platform_* and scope.site_* regions).

Mark entries in this region `safe`. Garbage collection removes an entry once both its clocks run out, and an instruction that nobody happens to read is exactly the kind of thing that would quietly disappear.
